747: Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.
748: A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate.
749: Anthy's older brother, the acting chairman of the academy. Although barely present in the first season of the show, he later plays a pivotal role in the second and third seasons.
750: Anthy's pet (whom she will only refer to as friend, but may be more properly described as a familiar). He is a small marmoset who acts as comedic relief. However, he also acts as an omen of bad fortune in certain episodes.
751: Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels.
752: The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.
753: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds.
754: Touga's little sister, the prototypical "queen bee" of the school. She is very fond of him to the point of their relationship having semi-incestuous edge, at least on her part.
755: Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy.
4363: She's Miki's twin sister who feels overshadowed by his talent and dirtied by comparison with him. Kozue resents Miki's affection for Anthy Himemiya and is prone to acting out to grab her brother's attention, most notably by exercising loose sexual morals.
6136: A master swordsman, Ruka is former captain of the fencing team and occasional member of the Student Council. He considers Juri to be the most talented member of the club and considers himself her mentor.
6137: Mikage is the head of the popular Mikage Seminar at Ohtori Academy.
6139: Akio's fiancee, daughter of the school's Trustee Chairman. She is unnerved by Anthy, who deliberately distances herself from Kanae.
6140: Nanami's most devoted lackey, a boy in fourth grade. He is obsessed with serving Nanami and wishes to be her adored "big brother", even going so far as to put her in danger in order to rescue her. Tsuwabuki does not appear in the movie.
6141: Utena's best friend. Wakaba's cheerful personality hides an enormous inferiority complex, and she attaches herself to Utena and other people to feel important. In the first episode ("The Rose Bride") she refers to Utena as her "boyfriend.
6142: Keiko is one of Nanami's three henchmen. Like many other girls at the school, she has a secret obsession with Touga. Keiko is in love with him and wishes only to be with him. However, she knows that Nanami's clout and Touga's rank makes it impossible to even approach him.
6143: The enigmatic prince from Utena's childhood. Dios's name, which means "God" in Spanish, as well as his presentation in the anime, suggest that he is to be considered Utena's guardian angel. During most of the duels, it is shown that his spirit enters Utena's body and aids her.
13094: Three girls (known as A-Ko, B-Ko, and C-Ko), seen only in silhouette, who spend about thirty seconds per episode energetically commentating on its events in symbolic allegory. Their antics provide both comic relief and insight into the show's plot.

13130: Tatsuya is a childhood friend of Wakaba's. When they were little, she recruited him as her "Onion Prince" to protect her from the taunts of her classmates.

34670: Mamiya Chiba is the boy who was Mikage's reason for creating the Black Rose Duelists. He is Tokiko Chida's younger brother, and quite ill.
42283: Mari is a classmate of Tsuwabuki's, who tries to act as his common sense. She seems slightly jealous of his attentions to Nanami — and interestingly, vice versa. Source: Wikipedia
42568: Mamiya's older sister, who primarily appears in the past. She was hired by Ohtori Academy to oversee Professor Nemuro's work, and immediately has a significant impact on him. Her compassion for her brother provokes feelings that Nemuro has difficulty quantifying.
